name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast. It balances visibility for low-vision users with compatibility across color modes and reduced-motion settings. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings on high-DPI screens, but that’s preferable to thin rings disappearing on monochrome or dim displays.

name: Reader
text: A 3px ring at 4.5:1 still fails on monochrome displays where the ring blends into backgrounds. Use a 4px ring at 7:1 contrast—it remains visible on patterned and monochrome screens without relying on color alone. Test with grayscale and high-contrast mode to confirm.
